rationale: Absolute ceilings, not a same-machine delta. Time ceilings are typically 3-7x the Apple M1 / macOS baseline recorded on 2026-11-16 and rounded up (looser for sub-millisecond and startup metrics), so a slower shared CI runner passes while an algorithmic regression fails. Two entries are deterministic and intentionally tight: render.v40.rgbaKiB guards an exact per-frame allocation, and fountain.stream.symbolsToComplete guards fountain overhead. `min` entries encode a floor where higher is better. Memory entries are coarse runaway guards: the measurement is an approximate retained heap + ArrayBuffer delta and varies between V8 versions. `pnpm bench:compare` is the separate 20% same-machine guardrail.

writer.json.plain.note: baseline ~6.4 ms; gzip + SHA-256 + split of 1 MiB JSON

writer.random.plain.note: baseline ~21 ms; gzip attempt + SHA-256 + split of 1 MiB incompressible data

writer.random.encodeRepair.note: baseline ~0.09 ms; sub-millisecond, so the ceiling is deliberately loose

writer.json.encrypted.note: baseline ~78 ms; dominated by 600k PBKDF2 iterations

writer.random.encrypted.note: baseline ~93 ms; dominated by 600k PBKDF2 iterations

fountain.stream.decode.note: baseline ~965 ms per 1 MiB lossy stream; 0.77 ms per accepted frame

fountain.stream.assemble.note: baseline ~0.17 ms; one memcpy into the 1 MiB payload

fountain.stream.symbolsToComplete.note: baseline 1254 accepted packets for k=1252 with a quarter of systematic frames dropped

render.v20.packetToMatrix.note: baseline ~11.7 ms; qrcode-generator mask selection dominates

render.v40.packetToMatrix.note: baseline ~39.5 ms; qrcode-generator mask selection dominates

render.v20.paintFrame.note: baseline ~12.4 ms; fake canvas, so real browser compositing is extra

render.v40.paintFrame.note: baseline ~40 ms; fake canvas, so real browser compositing is extra

render.v20.sustainedFps.note: fast preset rate; 15 fps needs a 66.7 ms frame budget

render.v40.sustainedFps.note: extreme preset rate; 6 fps needs a 166.7 ms frame budget

render.v40.rgbaKiB.note: 133.69 KiB exact at scale 1; guards accidental buffer growth

reader.stream.add.note: baseline ~965 ms for 1254 packets (CRC + plausibility + fountain)

reader.stream.reassemble.note: baseline ~972 ms including SHA-256 of 1 MiB

reader.frame.add.note: baseline ~0.77 ms per accepted frame at 15 fps

reader.zxing.startup.note: baseline ~10 ms; Node wasm compile with the binary already on disk

reader.zxing.720p.v20.note: baseline ~5.5 ms per frame; 15 fps allows 66.7 ms

reader.zxing.1080p.v40.note: baseline ~14.1 ms per frame; 6 fps allows 166.7 ms
